headline: AMD brings FSR 4.1 upscaling to Xbox consoles and handhelds
summary: AMD is bringing its FSR 4.1 upscaling technology to Xbox Series X and S consoles, handheld devices like the Xbox Ally X, older Radeon RX 6000-series GPUs, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9 and Z2 chips, extending the upscaler to older hardware.

claims.statement: AMD is bringing its FSR 4.1 upscaling technology to Xbox Series X/S consoles, handhelds, and older Radeon RX 6000-series GPUs.

sources.quote: AMD has just revealed that it's bringing its latest upscaling technology, FSR 4.1, to the Xbox Series S and X consoles, as well as laptops, 6000-series GPUs, and handhelds like the Xbox Ally X devices.
AMD's FSR 4.1 now works on Radeon RX 6000 cards, Xbox Series X and S, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 SoCs
AMD has released a version of its cutting-edge FSR 4.1 upscaler that now works on Radeon RX 6000 GPUs, Xbox Series X and Series S consoles, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 chips.
